title: A structure-preserving discretisation of SO(3)-rotation fields for finite Cosserat micropolar elasticity
summary: We introduce a new method, dubbed Geometric Structure-Preserving Interpolation ($Γ$-SPIN) to preserve physics-constraints inherent in the material parameter limits of the finite-strain Cosserat micropolar model. The method advocates to interpolate the Cosserat rotation tensor using geodesic elements, which maintain objectivity and correctly represent curvature measures. At the same time, it proposes relaxing the interaction between the rotation tensor and the deformation tensor to alleviate locking effects. This relaxation is achieved in two steps.
